heading: INT. HOLLOWAY VETERINARY CLINIC - WAITING ROOM - NIGHT

units.text: INT. HOLLOWAY VETERINARY CLINIC - WAITING ROOM - NIGHT
HANDHELD.
A phone camera, held at arm's length, swinging.
The picture is grainy, overexposed by the buzzing tube lights.
A timestamp burns in the corner: 11:47 PM.

NATE DUNN, 28, lanky, a beanie, a hoodie with the sleeves pushed up, holds the camera on himself, grinning too hard, a kid doing a bit he has done a hundred times for a channel with four hundred subscribers.
Okay so we're live. Not live live. Recording live. If you're new, I'm Nate, and tonight we are doing what the comments asked for, which is the abandoned vet clinic on Route 9.
units.name: NATE

units.text: He turns the camera.
The waiting room is wide, low-ceilinged, and wrong.
Plastic chairs bolted in rows.
A reception desk with a dead phone and a bowl of petrified dog biscuits.
On the wall, a faded poster, "Have You Hugged Your Pet Today?", a cartoon beagle smiling in a way that has gone sour.
So, lore. This place closed in 2009. Owner just kind of walked out one day. Left the files, left the meds, left, and this is the part I love, the animals.
units.name: NATE

units.text: He laughs.
It dies fast.
I mean not the animals. Obviously. Not the. Anyway.
units.name: NATE

units.text: The camera pushes toward a hallway on the far side of the desk.
At the mouth of it, a rusted gurney.
Beyond that, dark.
ON PHONE: A text banner drops from the top of the frame.
"MO: ur not seriously there rn"
That's my buddy Mo. He's scared of everything. Mo, I see you, I'm okay.
units.name: NATE

units.text: He types with one thumb, camera shaking, and we see over his shoulder the reply go out: "im fine. go to bed."
ON PHONE: "MO: nate. its midnight. come home."
He pockets the phone.

In the glass of the front door, behind him, there's a reflection of the empty lot outside, the van, the moon, and for a half second something low and pale moving past the van, something about the size of a dog.
He doesn't see it.
The camera does.
Okay! Hallway.
units.name: NATE
